missing.why: Light attacks grant Armor and Magic Resist from its passive, but MR isn't a base stat, so the Rule correctly excludes it. Players who know the item may try it; including it would be a Rule change (count passive stats), not data.
Gave MR for years before its rework; a common wrong answer. Rule-correct out (Armor + AD only now). No fix needed.
Historically an MR support item; players will try it. Rule-correct out (no MR stat on this patch).
Had MR in older versions and is a spell-shield item, so it 'feels' like MR. Rule-correct out.

disputable.why: Bandlepipes started life as an Arena item; many players won't believe it's in the SR shop. It passes this patch's SR shop filter, so keep it, but expect 'that's Arena-only' complaints.
Chainlaced Crushers is a tier-3 upgrade of Mercury's Treads from the boots upgrade system, not a normal buy. Players may argue it isn't a 'shop item'; it does appear in the SR shop data.
Doran's Helm is a recent starter; veterans may not know it exists or that it carries a little MR (8).
Players think of Banshee's Veil as an AP item and may be surprised it carries MR; membership is correct (40 MR).

wording.why: 'Gives Magic Resist' could be read to include passives that grant MR (Terminus light attacks, Hullbreaker minions). The Rule says stats only.
wording.suggestion: Name an item with Magic Resist in its stats

aliases.why: Common short form in build talk.

fun.why: Everyone can name Mercs, Spirit Visage or Negatron, but 22 answers spread across tanks, fighters, ADCs (Wit's End, Scimitar, Maw), mages (Banshee's, Verdant Barrier) and supports (Locket, Zeke's) mean few will get them all.
